registered: 2026-10-03 (KST), before any of these variants was run
purpose: The site's daily loss limit sells every position of the currency when the day's loss reaches the limit. Is that good for a month swing?
setup: portfolio.py on the site's pool, research filter, exit C, risk 0.5%, 30% per name, seeds KRW 7,000,000 / USD 750 (the new defaults). The day's loss is measured from the previous close's equity; a gap down past the limit sells at the open, otherwise a close past the limit sells at the close; no new buys that day.
adopt: The variant with the best MAR (CAGR / |max drawdown|) on develop in both markets becomes the default only if its holdout MAR is also at least D2's in both markets. Otherwise 2% stays.
